data.title: Which Crypto Use Cases Are Actually Growing? Jeff Dorman Says Bitcoin Isn’t One
data.description: Jeff Dorman, Chief Investment Officer and co-founder of Arca, says stablecoins, tokenization and DeFi are the only crypto use cases clearly growing, and that Bitcoin offers exposure to none of them.
